Name: Gems and Minerals to Monster Loot and Omnigeodes etc.
Author: mikemonroe
Description:
[b][size=4]What it does[/size][/b]

This mod adds a machine and machine rules to convert [b]5 slime[/b] and a [b]stack of 4 of any gem or mineral[/b] to a random pick of the following...

[list]
[*]20-40 coal,
[*]3-7 omni geodes,
[*]3-7 mystery boxes,

[*]1-3 artifact troves,
[*]7-13 bat wings,
[*]30-50 bug meat,
[*]3-7 solar essence,
[*]or 3-7 void essence.
[/list]
Any choice is just as likely as another, there is no weight to the selection, and the gem/mineral type doesn't have effect on the result either. The processing time is 1200 in-game minutes, or about one in-game day.

Optionally improves the bug steak by giving it mining-appropriate buffs and improved edibility (more energy/health restored), to give the bug meat more use (buffs may not be visible in the crafting window, default on).

Optionally adds a machine rule to the Slime-Egg Press to convert petrified slime to 50 slime (default on).

The machine is unlocked at combat level 1 (it's a recolored Slime Incubator)

All gems and minerals listed [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Minerals]here[/url]﻿ should work. Modded minerals and gems work if they use the same context tag as vanilla.

[size=4][b]Caveats/Limitations
[/b][/size]
Slime-Egg Press converts slime to slime eggs so be careful with automate when converting petrified slime to slime.

Bug reports, balance suggestions etc. are welcome as always.
